record.question: Is it dangerous to leave the secondary of a PT open-circuited?
options: Yes, it will produce a high voltage and cause a flashover
Yes, it will damage the primary winding
No, a PT is a voltage source and is designed to operate with an open secondary (no load)
No, it will only damage the core
